title: Disembodied Machine Learning: On the Illusion of Objectivity in NLP
findings: The paper does not analyze or mention religion/faith. Its focus is on the inherent subjectivity and social biases (such as those related to race and gender) in machine learning and NLP, arguing against the illusion of objectivity. The term 'God trick' is used in its philosophical sense from Donna Haraway's work to critique a disembodied, objective viewpoint, not in a theological context.
